findings.title: namesRealCode treats a partial mention of a fixture PR path as real code
findings.action: Skip tokens that match a fixture prefix with or without a trailing slash, and count a PR-path suffix match as real code only when a matched PR path is non-fixture.
findings.disposition_rationale: Fixed in ab802bc4 and verified in pass 3: `x-001.json`, `cases/x-001.json` and `eval/cases` all cap in a fixture-only PR; covered by the partial-path test (36/36).

occurrences.title: namesRealCode treats a partial mention of a fixture PR path as real code

findings.title: cwd-relative existence check in namesRealCode
findings.action: Optionally pass the repo root to capFixtureFindings from main() instead of relying on process.cwd().
findings.disposition_rationale: Run from outside the repo, an unchanged real path named only in prose no longer blocks the cap; behaviour then falls back to the spec's own procedure (step 4d plus the origin check), so no spec AC is violated. Non-blocking follow-up.
